description: Create an invoice. Accepts item/customer/department names (will lookup IDs automatically). Either customer_name or customer_id is REQUIRED — invoices must have a customer. Lines use SalesItemLineDetail (product/service references, not accounts). Returns invoice details and a link to view in QuickBooks.

allow_online_ach_payment.description: Allow customer to pay this invoice via bank transfer (ACH) online. Must be explicitly set — company defaults do not apply via API.

allow_online_credit_card_payment.description: Allow customer to pay this invoice with a credit card online. Must be explicitly set — company defaults do not apply via API.

bill_email.description: Email address to send the invoice to. Required if you want QuickBooks to email the invoice.

customer_id.description: Customer ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use customer_name)

customer_memo.description: Customer-facing message visible on the invoice

customer_name.description: Customer display name (e.g., 'Cash Sales'). Will be looked up to get ID.

department_id.description: Header-level department/location ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use department_name)

department_name.description: Header-level department/location name (e.g., '20358', 'Cotati'). Will be looked up to get ID.

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without creating (default: true)

lines.description: Array of line items. Each line references an item (product/service). Provide item_name OR item_id (name preferred).

amount.description: Line amount (positive or negative). Negative for adjustments/discounts.

item_id.description: Item ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use item_name)

item_name.description: Item (product/service) name (e.g., 'Sales', 'Catering'). Will be looked up to get ID.

unit_price.description: Price per unit (if omitted, computed from amount / qty)

memo.description: Private memo for the invoice (internal, not visible to customer)

sales_term_ref.description: Payment terms name (e.g., 'Net 30', 'Due on receipt'). Will be looked up to get ID.

name: create_invoice
